- Overestimate prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; reduce initial forecast by 2–5%.
- Underestimate prices during prolonged downward trends; adjust upward by 3–7% if recent 7–14 day average is falling.
- Overshoot after sharp upward moves; cap forecast at +3–5% above recent 14-day high.
- Underestimate during prolonged upward trends; add 1–3% to forecast if 14-day average is rising >1.5%.
- Lag in response to recent price drops; delay forecast correction by 1–3 days if price fell >3% in last 7 days.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 1–2% per day until convergence.
- Forecast drifts upward in late window; cap forecast at 10% below 30-day high if price is rising >2% per day for 3+ days.
